LOCKOUT from the burner control box: 1 = locked out (C0xe)
BR02 fuel selector: 1 = diesel. BR01: FALSE
Daily stop used for BR01 only (C07h)
Heat request to the burner: TL / L (E1 / E3)
Stage 2 request to the burner: TR / T2 (E2 / E4)
START button state from the previous scan
Fuel selector state from the previous scan
Higher of the two thermocouples, 0.1 degC
AUTO restart temperature = SP - HYST, 0.1 degC
Stage 2 ON below SP - STG, 0.1 degC
Stage 2 OFF at SP - STG + 2.0 degC, 0.1 degC
AUTO: heat demand between restart temperature and SP
Heat is needed in the selected mode
Burner must stop and needs a new START: E-STOP, scrubber trip, lockout, thermocouple fault or fuel change
START accepted; cleared by STOP or Trip
Daily stop after 24 h of request (BR01, C07h)
Alarm: heat request without RUN for 120 s (C0xf)
Alarm: RUN without heat request for 30 s (C0xg)

AttributeList.Text: One burner: START/STOP, heat request TL/L, stage 2 TR/T2, alarms. Flame safety belongs to the burner control box.
START edge and fuel change, in Rev B order. OB100 suppresses held START. B-01 / C08h.
Buttons
Validate both sensors, select MAX, calculate thresholds in Rev B order. C07b / C08b / C07c / C08c / C07d / C08d.
Temperature
SET before RESET: invalid temperature or SP wins. C07b / C08b / B-01.
Heat demand
Raw E-STOP, scrubber, lockout, temperature or fuel trip before START/STOP. C01 / C03 / C05 / C07d / C08d / C07e / C08e / C08h.
Trip
Accept new START; STOP or trip RESET follows and wins. B-01 / C01 / C03 / C05.
START / STOP
Read previous scan HeatReq; 60 s pause RESET follows 24 h SET. C07h.
Daily stop
Request and lamp share rung; MAN cancellation follows. C07a / C08a / C07b / C08b / E1 / E3 / B-01.
Heat request
SET before RESET, then copy the final stage state to lamp. C07c / C08c / E2 / E4.
Stage 2
NoRun and RunWrong are alarms only; then display bits from HMI_ALARMS. C07e / C08e / C07d / C08d / C07f / C08f / C07g / C08g / C07a / C08a.
